lyrics:
[Intro: solo piano, slow warm chords]

[Verse 1: smooth, conversational, piano only]
You navigate by feeling and you've never once been right
You sing the wrong words loudly and you leave on every light
You're early when I'm late and you are late when I'm on time
And I wouldn't change a minute of this mismanaged life of mine

[Pre-Chorus: piano builds, voice lifts]
My head keeps the map
My heart threw it out

[Chorus: full voice into falsetto, piano broad]
You're my favorite wrong turn
My best mistake
My lost and found, my give and take
You're the long way home I would choose again
My favorite wrong turn
You're where I meant to end

[Verse 2: smooth, smiling]
You argue with the weather and you bargain with the cat
You said we'd stay an hour, and it's been years since that
The plans I had were tidy and they wouldn't have been true
Every road I didn't mean to take was leading me to you

[Pre-Chorus: piano builds, voice lifts]
My head keeps the map
My heart threw it out

[Chorus: full voice into falsetto, soft strings]
You're my favorite wrong turn
My best mistake
My lost and found, my give and take
You're the long way home I would choose again
My favorite wrong turn
You're where I meant to end

[Bridge: quiet, almost spoken, single piano notes]
So get us lost
I'll hold the bags
Get us lost
I'm glad

[Final Chorus: biggest, held falsetto note, strings]
You're my favorite wrong turn
My best mistake
My lost and found, my give and take
You're the long way home I would choose again
My favorite wrong turn
You're where I meant to end

[Outro: piano alone, last chord held]
Where I meant to end
producerBrief:
TEMPO / KEY / FEEL: 63 BPM, 4/4, A-flat major. Slow, warm and unhurried. A private song in a quiet room.

VOICE: Male tenor, smooth and warm with a soul and gospel background. Verses nearly spoken, with a smile in them. The chorus climbs into a clear, sweet falsetto on the top lines. One long held falsetto note in the last chorus. No backing vocals.

INSTRUMENTS: A grand piano playing broad, slow chords with small gospel turns. A soft string section that enters in the second chorus and grows in the last. Nothing else. No drums.

ARRANGEMENT MAP: 0:00 Intro, piano. 0:15 Verse 1. 0:53 Pre-chorus. 1:04 Chorus 1. 1:34 Verse 2. 2:12 Pre-chorus. 2:23 Chorus 2, strings. 2:53 Bridge, single piano notes, almost spoken. 3:08 Final chorus with the held falsetto note. 3:38 Outro, piano alone, the last chord held to 3:50.

PRODUCTION & MIX: A classic piano ballad recording: warm, close and clean, the piano wide, the voice in the centre with a little plate reverb.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: The step up into falsetto on the first line of the chorus.

MODERN POINT OF VIEW: This is a song from the far side of the wedding. The evidence is years of wrong directions and left-on lights, and 'where I meant to end' is said by someone who has seen where the tidy plan would have led.

EMOTIONAL ARC: Affectionate complaint, gratitude, a vow renewed.
